proposal.reason: Main change is review-routing policy/automation behavior, owned by workflow: .github/scripts/review_automation.py adds typed withdrawal fallback (withdraw_review_requests/pending_review_requests), changes classification freshness/fingerprint inputs, and treats patch_omitted files as manual-review data instead of hard failure; .github/scripts/maintainer_approval.py aligns gate freshness checks to PR head/target; .github/workflows/review-routing.yml skips title/body-only edited events. These are contribution/review workflow rules and assignment mechanics, not PCCL runtime module behavior.
